meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上该技能后,Claude 每次回复前会自动检索并调出之前存下的相关记忆,并在每轮对话后把新信息存入记忆库。记忆跨会话保留,即使容器重启也不丢失。
howto.when: 当代理容器使用默认 Claude 提供商(未设置 provider 或为 claude)时,每次回复前触发记忆检索,每轮对话结束后存入新记忆。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次聊过这个项目的重点吗?
say.note: Claude 会先从记忆中调取上次对话的相关内容。

say.text: 把这次的结论记下来,下次继续讨论。
say.note: 回合结束后,Claude 会把它存入持久记忆。

say.text: 根据你对我偏好的记忆,推荐一个方案。
say.note: 这会触发它回忆你之前提供的偏好信息。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude automatically retrieves relevant past memories before each reply and stores new insights after each turn. Memories persist across sessions and container restarts.
howto.when_en: Only under the default Claude provider (absent or "claude" in container.json), memory recall is triggered before each reply, and new insights are stored after each turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the key points from our last chat about this project?
say_en.note: Claude recalls relevant context from memory before answering.

say_en.text: Note this conclusion down—we'll continue next time.
say_en.note: After the turn, Claude stores the insight persistently.

say_en.text: Based on your memory of my preferences, recommend a plan.
say_en.note: This triggers recall of previously provided preferences.
